hero.title: Your account.
paragraphs: Change your password, view purchases or manage account data. Choose and manage projects in [the project chat](/ai-chat/projects/example).

account.title: Change password
paragraphs: Enter your current password, then enter the new password twice.

items.title: Repeat password
items.text: Check that the two entries match.

purchases.title: Tokens and purchases
paragraphs: View your current token balance, purchase history and receipts. [Buy tokens](/ai-chat/tokens) to continue a saved task when the balance restricts new paid AI requests.

privacy.title: Materials and deletion
paragraphs: The service sends relevant material to external AI providers for your requested work. Read [How your materials are processed and stored](/ai-chat/projects/example#how-your-materials-are-processed-and-stored) before deleting your account.

Deletion removes your account and the active data the service controls across all your projects, including uploaded material, documents and conversations. Contabo backups may retain copies for up to six months; the service cannot shorten that period.

links.text: How your materials are processed and stored

danger.title: Delete account and project data
paragraphs: Review the account and all project data that will be removed before you confirm. Choose **Cancel** to keep your account and data.

recovery.title: When a change cannot be saved
paragraphs: If a change fails, your previous setting or last saved document stays in place. Retry the change or ask for help. If deletion fails, check the result before trying again.

success.title: Password changed
paragraphs: Your new password is saved. Return to your workspace to keep working.
